description: Expected bytes derived by hand from the rule text at rc.5 (RC5-A); the reference engine does not yet produce them, so this vector is listed in tests/conformance/pending.json until RC5-B. AGSC-08-06 carries a complete ABNF for the DCO-Plus trailer block and was cited by no vector before rc.5 (V9A-26), although the grammar costs exactly one vector to pin. Every case below is read straight off that ABNF. (1) A bare signoff conforms: `signoff = "Signed-off-by:" SP name SP "<" email ">" SP "(" agreement ")"`, with `agreement = "CA-v1"`; `name` admits internal spaces (`nchar *( nchar / SP )`) and the email boundary is disambiguated greedily by the LAST `SP "<"` on the line. (2) `trailer-block = signoff *( LF assisted )` admits zero or more Assisted-by lines, whose `actor` is exactly the `human:<id>` form AGSC-02-07 requires of prov.operator, so a valid trailer exists for every valid item. (3) A missing `(CA-v1)` is malformed. (4) `name` MUST NOT end with SP. (5) An actor that is not `human:<id>` — an agent string — is malformed; AGSC-08-08 is the reason the grammar has no other actor form. (6) An `idchar` outside `lcalpha / DIGIT / "." / "_" / "-"` — an upper-case letter — is malformed, because `lcalpha` is %x61-7A. Every malformed case is AGSC-E504.
